channel.title: GameDō Studio Blog
channel.description: Devlogs, postmortems and game development notes from GameDō Studio.

item.title: GravityShot Postmortem: I Shipped a Tiny Mobile Puzzle Game
item.description: I shipped a small physics puzzle game in Godot 4.6, on nights and weekends, around a day job and a family. Here is what went right, what went wrong, and the cent of revenue that proves it.

item.title: How Much Does It Cost to Port an Indie Game to Consoles? (2026)
item.description: A porting house charges $10,000 to $50,000 per platform. On Unity or Unreal, a port mostly costs time: 3 to 6 months per console. Here is the full 2026 breakdown, from dev kits to certification.

item.title: Game Feel 101: Why Your Indie Game Doesn't Feel Satisfying Yet
item.description: Screen shake, hitstop, particles, and camera tricks. The six techniques that separate good indie games from great ones.

item.title: Godot vs Unity vs Unreal Engine: Which One Should You Pick in 2026?
item.description: A no-nonsense breakdown of the three biggest game engines for indie developers. Pricing, performance, learning curve, and the games that prove each one works.
